title: +*INTRODUCTION TO PSYCHOLOGY I
description: Introduces science and application of psychology. Emphasizes psychological concepts, theories, and principles related to: Research Methods, Behavioral Neuroscience, Consciousness, Sensation/Perception, Learning, Memory, Thinking and Intelligence, and related topics.
registration_restrictions: Enrollment limited to students in a Honors Bachelor of Arts, Honors Bachelor of Fine Arts, Honors Bachelor of Music or Honors Bachelor of Science degrees.
